comments: 34e0ba1f: ;This routine processes mumps-specific database code structures.
0b763658: Get the event date.
fe03e338: If the event date is before the admission date, set event date to admission date and display message.
78b821e5: If the event date is after the discharge date, set event date to discharge date and display message.
ead107c3: If the type is 1 (Lodger), set the starting date/time for the admission period.
85487272: If the type is not 1, set the starting date/time for the admission period.
d6d39761: If the source is 1 (Local), call IN5^VADPT to get patient information.
369012d1: If the patient is an inpatient, set the default response for the ward.
124d1aae: Get the ward and set the ward code and associated service.
1f8ed0bb: If the patient is an inpatient, set the default response for the specialty.
691d3c2c: Get the specialty and set the specialty code.
46af48b4: If the ward service is not found, get the service from the ward file.
c8a04fe1: If the ward service is found, get the service from the associated service file.
3decbf57: If the service is not found or is 0, set it to 12 (Other). Otherwise, get the service name and set it as the default response.
21963b56: Ask the user to enter a DGJTSV value and store it.
bf5fefe1: If DGJTSR1 is 1, set the DIR("B") parameter to the second piece of DGJTDEL.
14d29e65: Ask the user to enter a DGJT1PH value and store it.
6c106492: If the third piece of DGJTDEL is 0 and the tenth piece is 'A', set X to the tenth piece of DGJTDEL if DGJTSR1 is 1. Otherwise, set X to an empty string.
23acfc79: ;Check if the 3rd piece of DGJTDEL is 1 and if DGJTSR1 is 1. If so, set X to the 4th piece of DGJTDEL.

cfbec43a: ;If the 3rd piece of DGJTDEL is 1 or if the 3rd piece is 0 and the 10th piece is 'A', and if DGJTSR1 is 1, execute the DOC routine. Set DIR('B') to X if X is non-empty. Set DIR(0) to '393,.1' and execute the ^DIR routine. If the user entered '^' or if DTOUT is defined, go to the Q label. If Y is not equal to -1, set DGJT2PH to Y if Y is non-empty, or to '@' if Y is empty.
3c46fcbb: ;Set DIR('B') to the name of the provider (1st piece of the 0 node of the PROVIDER file entry) if DGJT1PH is non-empty, or leave it blank otherwise.
1d0bb145: ;Set DIR(0) to '393,.12' and execute the ^DIR routine. If the user entered '^' or if DTOUT is defined, go to the Q label. Set DGJTPR to the value of Y. Kill DIR('B').
edeb1c53: Create a new entry in the file 393 for the current patient and set DGSENFLG to null.
8577e6e9: Set DGJTEDT to the internal entry number of the new entry concatenated with '1^'. Set DIE to the global root for file 393 and DA to the internal entry number.

29f8b887: If the record type is not an OP REPORT, DISCHARGE SUMMARY, or INTERIM SUMMARY, set DR to the input template for entering deficiency information and call the DIE utility to edit the new record.
713d597d: If the record type is an OP REPORT, DISCHARGE SUMMARY, or INTERIM SUMMARY, set DR to the input template for entering IRT record information.
f785271e: Call the DIE utility to edit the new record.
df2be85d: Call the INIT1^DGJTEE2 procedure to initialize something related to IRT editing.
816e5987: Exit if the user has selected a caret or timed out.
66add81f: Exit if no selection is made.
c3f10d43: Scan the VAS OTHER ADMISSION EVENT file and process all unedited events for this patient.
8876ba2a: Exit the routine.
9119c20c: Process the admission event and set the necessary flags and variables.
f093d4cf: Set additional variables and flags for the admission event.
b605bc69: Exit the SCR1 sub-routine.
d6c0cc00: Check if the division for the event matches the current division. Set a flag if not.
a81d52e4: Get the status of the event (signed or reviewed).
2cf39d19: Get the internal entry number for the signed or reviewed status.

d8cc876f:  ;
Get the physician code for the treating physician on the admission event.
;The code is stored in the DGPM MOVEMENT file (#393.1) and is a pointer to the
;NEW PERSON file (#200). This code retrieves the pointer value by traversing
;the backward pointers from the DGPM MOVEMENT file to the DGPM ADMISSION file
;(#393) and then to the DGPM file (#391.1).
725cda82: Get the physician's name from the NEW PERSON file.
